We’re EDIT Saffron: 11 students at Lo‑Ellen Park who design, program, machine and wire a robot for the FIRST Tech Challenge.

Meet the team

Our robot

  1. This season’s robot

    Designed in Fusion and built by the team.

  2. Five assemblies

    Drivebase, intake, indexer, shooter and sensors.

  3. Every part, modelled

    Parts are drawn in CAD before they’re cut, printed or machined in the EDIT Lab.

  4. Ready for BIOBUZZ
